name: Meteor Shower
overview: Chu Yuxun's life takes an unexpected turn when she discovers she is the destined heroine of a romance drama. Refusing to follow a prewritten path, she focuses on her studies and dreams of a brighter future. To keep the school's influential H4 group at a distance, she agrees to a contract relationship with Murong Yunhai, a rebellious heir. As their fake romance turns real, Yuxun finds herself facing challenges that force her to redefine both love and her own future.
